description: Suno Studio effect. Tightens a boomy low end by removing sub-rumble, taming the low band with an envelope follower, and adding controlled low-shelf weight. Apply to the rendered BASS stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Tightens a boomy low end by removing sub-rumble, taming the low band with an envelope follower, and adding controlled low-shelf weight.

hp freq.description: Highpass corner that removes sub-rumble below the usable bass.
hp freq.label: HP Freq

tighten.description: How much the low band boom is tamed by its envelope follower; higher tightens more.
tighten.label: Tighten

warmth.description: Low-shelf weight near 90Hz for controlled body after tightening.
warmth.label: Warmth

drive.description: Pre-safety saturation drive into the tanh stage for solidity.
drive.label: Drive

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
